original_test_intent: Verify the complete thermal-sensor set associated with the motherboard 1G management-LAN controller or port, reconciling identity, location and values across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web with the approved specification.
original_method: Bind motherboard revision, 1G LAN controller, BMC/shared/dedicated port and physical sensor location; determine the complete TEMP_MB_1G_LAN population; retain aligned full IB/OOB inventories and Web pages; compare units, values, states, thresholds and freshness while passively correlating controller/link and thermal health.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner identifies the exact 1G management-LAN controller/port/sensor set and resolves criteria 3–25; an operator confirms Web mapping and the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Shared-versus-dedicated BMC LAN role and exact sensor physical location
TEMP_MB_1G_LAN population and authoritative sensor spec
Per-member IB/OOB/Web map, units, expected values/states, thresholds and freshness
Normal link state, speed, traffic/workload and environmental context
Secure access, complete Web capture, timing/cache/rounding rules and criteria 3–25 disposition
safety_requirements: Keep collection passive; do not reconfigure LAN, flap links, change BMC channels or write thresholds
Protect credentials and retain full output before filtering
Bind each sensor to exact controller/port; reject the test title as a record
Do not truncate or clear network/thermal/BMC/host evidence
Stop on ambiguous mapping, missing/duplicate/stale data, channel mismatch, link loss or thermal alarm
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Apply owner-approved LAN controller/port/sensor mapping and normalize fields
Correlate passive link/controller and thermal state and prepare Web parity
Perform no LAN/link/threshold action, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve LAN scope, controller/port map, sensor population and expected semantics
Resolve criteria-number gap and omitted LAN checks
Review all members and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - LAN'` invents a target and OOB-only/truncated output omits IB, Web and correct controller/port mapping.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, select every approved TEMP_MB_1G_LAN record, capture all Web rows and correlate passive controller/link state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, TEMP_MB_1G_LAN view, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; no log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join physical motherboard controller/port identity to stable sensor records and compare complete IB/OOB/Web telemetry with passive link and workload context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact management-port attribution and full population completeness without touching network configuration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: LAN can mean multiple host or management interfaces; a single temperature value cannot prove the intended MB 1G controller or every mapped record.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared/dedicated modes and firmware may rename or suppress records; versioned mapping is required.

project_override_considerations: If exactly one TEMP_MB_1G_LAN sensor exists, its controller/port and physical location must still be documented. This row does not authorize failover or cable tests.
expected_evidence: 1G management-LAN controller/port/role/location and versioned sensor spec/map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence bound to the intended LAN sensor set
Passive link/workload/thermal context, criteria 3–25 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: LAN is broad while the procedure filters TEMP_MB_1G_LAN without a controller/port map, and criteria jump from 2 to 26. DeepSeek invents a title sensor and omits source-required views.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive LAN-sensor reconciliation is feasible after scope, mapping and criteria are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2022 Wistron-BMC-01042-V002: define the exact motherboard 1G management-LAN controller/port and whether `TEMP_MB_1G_LAN` is one sensor or the complete LAN sensor set; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 26 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–25 are missing, and provide the full IB/OOB/Web acceptance map.

review_improvement: Prevents generic LAN scope from being satisfied by an invented title record, adds controller/port traceability and exposes the twenty-three-number criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: Servers can have multiple host NICs plus shared and dedicated management interfaces. TEMP_MB_1G_LAN implies a specific motherboard 1G device, so the physical/controller map is necessary to avoid accepting the wrong NIC's sensor. Cross-view equality proves reporting consistency but not completeness. Link state and workload affect temperature, and criteria 3–25 cannot be inferred.
